description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Awoken Thief], [Damage Cap +10000], [Treasure Rush Follow-Up] and [Zidane Trance] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Awoken Thief
description.text: Thief abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Treasure Rush Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Treasure Rush after using two Thief abilities

description.name: Zidane Trance
description.text: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES, MND, ACC, EVA and SPD +15%, instantly casts Thief abilities
